entries.previousAppearance: Young tan Caninu dog policeman Waffle Ryebread in blue cap and police clothes, clearly seated inside his round blue-gray two-legged Police Robo with long complete mechanical grab arms and a short bubble nozzle.
entries.appearance: Waffle is a small yellow-tan Caninu dog with pointed ears, orange-blond fringe, BLUE peaked police cap, pale blue uniform shirt with red tie, dark gray trousers, white gloves and dark boots. He remains visibly seated inside the COMPLETE Police Robo: cream-gray/taupe round metal torso, segmented BROWN articulated long arms, blue-gray short legs, metal claw hands, red cockpit seat and TWO tall back exhaust pipes. The short central front nozzle is the bubble blaster. Both pilot and complete robot remain in every pose.
entries.weapon: actual cream-gray Police Robo with brown segmented grab arms and front bubble blaster
entries.sourceDescription: The USA manual printedpages4 and6 depicts the Police Robo’s cream-gray body, brown segmented arms, blue-gray legs, red seat and twin back pipes. Printedpage23 depicts Waffle’s blue uniform and red tie. The bubble arrests nonlethally; controls include grab, throw and bubble blaster.
entries.reason: Actual primary manual scan opened and read before this character’s first generation. The historical local image/catalogue is not canonical proof.

entries.previousAppearance: Adult-stylised orange-haired Felineko Alicia Pris with cat ears, black eyepatch, red practical aviator jacket, dark shorts over opaque leggings, boots and gloves; no giant mecha summoned into a body cell.
entries.appearance: Felineko cat girl Alicia Pris with DARK fur and prominent pale WHITE-BLOND swept front hair, large black cat ears with pink interiors, one blue eye and a black eyepatch over her RIGHT eye (viewer left), black cat tail. Source costume: sleeveless RED fitted vest/top with GOLD piping, loose RED harem trousers, WHITE gloves and dark boots. Friendly neutral unarmed full-body acting; no aviator jacket, orange hair, shorts or tights.
entries.weapon: Black Cat rescue route signals, unarmed; no Iron Giant control powers
entries.sourceDescription: The USA manual printedpage17 shows Alicia with white-blond front hair over dark fur, right-eye eyepatch, red-and-gold top, loose red trousers and white gloves. She is the eldest Pris sister and Black Cats leader. Late-game route support is a declared crossover adaptation, not a summoned Iron Giant.

entries.previousAppearance: Tall Caninu Cyan Garland in blue-white Royal Guard field uniform, short cape, gloves and boots; upright practical rescue posture. Existing saber attribution is withheld pending independent source confirmation.
entries.appearance: Caninu dog Captain Cyan Garland with pale yellow-tan muzzle, blue-gray swept hair, large pointed ears and one gold hoop earring. RED tall military shako with gold trim and a blue-white badge, RED-and-GOLD formal Royal Guard tunic over dark navy/green lower coat, dark gray loose trousers, WHITE gloves and dark gold-trimmed boots. A complete golden-hilt ceremonial saber may remain safely sheathed at his side. No blue-white armor or cape.
entries.weapon: royal rescue coordination, with source ceremonial saber safely sheathed; no fabricated saber attack
entries.sourceDescription: The USA manual printedpage21 identifies Cyan as Captain of the Prairie Palace Guard and skilled Knight Robo pilot. It depicts his red-and-gold uniform and sword; the earlier blue-white armor palette was incorrect. This action remains rescue coordination, not an unverified playable sword combo.
